topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: I don’t know what to do about Old Tom and his fence. The thought of it gnaws at me like a fox in the henhouse. We’ve shared this land, our fields running side by side for generations, and now he speaks of boundaries and posts. What will the neighbors say? What will the land say? The soil knows no fences, it’s all one field to the wheat and the rain. If he builds that fence, it will change things, make them smaller, harder. We have enough troubles with the taxes and the poor yield this year. May the saints preserve us, I pray to St. Michael every evening, but I fear even his good grace can’t fix this. How do I talk to him? How do we remain neighbors?
